name: TUVALU

flag.title: Flag of Tuvalu
flag.note: Nine gold stars on Pacific blue, Union Jack

lead: Tuvalu is one of the tiniest nations on Earth. It has nine flat coral islands in the Pacific. The highest point is barely 5 metres. About 11,000 people live here. Rising seas threaten its future.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Tuvalu lies halfway between Hawaii and Australia. Its nine islands are coral atolls, rings of reef on old volcanoes. They are so flat that boats barely spot them. The land totals just 26 km².
There are no rivers at all. People drink rain caught on rooftops. Each lagoon is bright turquoise, ringed by coconut palms.
animals: Blacktip reef sharks patrol the shallows, dark fin tips slicing the surface. Giant Napoleon wrasse, fish with a funny forehead bump, glide through coral gardens.
Green sea turtles lay eggs on sandy islets in the Funafuti Conservation Area. The tiny Tuvalu skink lives nowhere else on Earth.
culture: In the fatele group dance, singers repeat each verse faster and faster until everyone laughs. The maneapa, an open meeting house, is the heart of village life.
Food comes from the sea and the coconut palm: fresh fish, coconut cream, and pulaka root. Whole villages play ano, volleying two hard pandanus-leaf balls at high speed.
history: Polynesian navigators settled Tuvalu over 2,000 years ago, guided by stars and ocean swells. By 1916, Britain had merged it into the Gilbert and Ellice Islands Colony.

In 1974, Tuvaluans voted to govern themselves separately. Tuvalu became fully independent on 1 October 1978. In 2023, it rewrote its constitution to say statehood lasts forever, even if the sea swallows every island.
wows: Tuvalu's internet code is .tv, and licensing it earns about $10 million a year.
The first .tv million paid Tuvalu's UN membership fee in 2000.
Funafuti's airport runway doubles as the town's sports field and market.
In 2023, Tuvalu rewrote its constitution so it legally exists even if its land sinks.
Only officials may own cars on Funafuti, which has no room for more.
The whole country has just 8 km of paved road.
Tuvalu's flag has nine stars, placed like its nine islands.

myths.myth: Coral is a kind of rock
myths.fact: Coral is made of tiny animals called polyps. Their hard skeletons pile up into reefs and islands.
Blacktips are shy. They eat small fish and swim away from people.
